diagnostics.message: The Prometheus Helm release uses local.namespace_name rather than the created namespace, and create_namespace defaults to false in helm-addon. It must wait for kubernetes_namespace_v1.prometheus.

The Prometheus chart disables server service-account creation, but its release does not wait for irsa_amp_ingest to create amp-ingest and attach its permissions. Referencing the IAM-role ARN alone does not wait for the service account or policy attachments.

The Spark history server reads the logs/ path at startup, but the add-ons module only references the bucket and does not wait for aws_s3_object.this to create that prefix marker. This can cause startup failure when the log directory does not yet exist.
The ADOT add-on waits for its Role but not the RoleBinding granting eks:addon-manager those permissions. Installation can begin before the required namespaced authorization exists.
The ADOT add-on waits for its ClusterRole but not the ClusterRoleBinding granting eks:addon-manager cluster permissions, allowing installation to race required authorization.
